Library Fine Management System
Problem Statement

Design a C++ program to manage library book records using classes and access specifiers.

Create a class LibraryBook that stores book details and calculates fine based on delayed return days.

The program must demonstrate:

Proper class structure

Use of private data members

Use of public member functions

User input-based execution

Requirements
Private Data Members:

string bookTitle

int bookID

int daysLate

double fineAmount

Public Member Functions:

void setDetails(string title, int id, int lateDays)

Assign values to private members.

void calculateFine()

Fine rules:

If daysLate <= 5 → ₹2 per day

If daysLate > 5 → ₹5 per day

void display()

Display output in format:

Book Title: <title>
Book ID: <id>
Days Late: <daysLate>
Fine: <fineAmount upto 2 decimal places>

Input Format

Single line input:

bookTitle bookID daysLate

Output Format

Display book details exactly as specified above.
